department: Department of Biological and Biomedical Engineering

deadline.value: January 15 for Fall 2027, international and Canadian applicants (also the Engineering fellowship nomination deadline).
deadline.quote: Application Deadline - International | FALL September 15 January 15 January 15

supervisor.value: A research supervisor must accept you; you may apply before contacting one, but contacting supervisors early improves your chances.
supervisor.quote: Applicants to the Ph.D. program who meet all of the academic requirements must also be accepted by a research supervisor before they are accepted as a student into the program.

funding.value: Doctoral students are guaranteed a minimum stipend: 4 years if starting at PhD 1, 3 years at PhD 2.
funding.quote: All thesis Master's and Doctoral students are guaranteed support under our minimum-stipend policy | Students starting at PhD1 have funding guaranteed for 4 years.

entry_route.value: You need a research-based master's in BBME or a related field.
entry_route.quote: Applicants for the Ph.D. Program must already hold a research-based Master's degree in Biological and Biomedical Engineering or related field

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 with at least 20 in each section.
toefl_min.quote: A total score of at least 100 on the Internet-based test with a minimum score of 20 in each section.

ielts_min.quote: An International English Language Testing System (IELTS) with a band score of 7.0 or greater (Academic module).
